metadata.notes: All 8 primary targets satisfy max(m*n, n*p, m*p) <= 64 (single uint64 bit-packed word per factor) and are confirmed genuinely open as of 2026-11-22.

source_2026.ZT_Z_Q: VERIFIED: Fawzi et al. (AlphaTensor, Nature 2022) & Perminov ZT (FastMatrixMultiplication status.json 2026-11-16) & Lille fmm_sota.json (2026-11-15) — R = 76

top_targets.rationale: Largest open small-format Z2-vs-char0 lifting gap in FMM (3 multiplications: 73 vs 76), untouched in char 0 since 2022. Tiny max_flat=25 enables >1B steps/s uint64 GPU walks; any char-0 scheme with R<=75 is an instant world record, and R<=74 breaks Strassen's exponent (omega=2.803848 < 2.807355).
top_targets.attack_strategy: Dual-prong: (1) GPU uint64 Z2 flip-graph harvesting diverse non-isomorphic basins at R=75, 74, 73 filtered by an inline mod-4 / mod-8 Hensel-liftability oracle + OR-Tools/Z3 ternary sign solver; (2) SLEEP-DAG-RSI direct ZT meta-flip tunneling bridging 4x4x5:61 (extend), 5x5x5:93 (project), and 4x5x6:90 (project) plus Z3/Z5 walks to capture Z[1/2] lifts.

source_2026.Z2: VERIFIED: Kauers & Wood (Oct 2025, arXiv:2510.19787 Table 5; github.com/mkauers/matrix-multiplication/456/*.mod2.exp) & Perminov (Nov 2025, arXiv:2511.20317 Table 3) — R_Z2 = 89

top_targets.rationale: Active 2025-2026 1-rank lifting gap (89 vs 90); sits +1.0 above linear midpoint (89.0) of 3x5x6:68 and 5x5x6:110. Only 2 mod-2 schemes were archived in mkauers/456; max_flat=30 fits in a single uint32 word.
top_targets.attack_strategy: Massively sample diverse Z2 rank-89 orbits on RTX 5060 (warp-level generalized flips + plus-tunneling from mkauers/456 mod2 seeds and ZT 90 seeds) paired with mod-4 Hensel-oracle ranking and guided constrained lifting (Perminov Sec 4.6) + ZT meta-flip projection from 5x5x6:110 and 4x5x7:104.

top_targets.track: Track B (Pure Rank Reduction — Ridge Collapse)

top_targets.rationale: Extreme +5.0 convexity ridge between 6x6x6:153 (Moosbauer-Poole 2025) and 6x6x8:203 (<2,2,2:7> x <3,3,4:29>, midpoint=178.0); +6.32 multiplications above Strassen scaling (omega=2.826414). Fits cleanly inside single uint64 (max_flat=42).
top_targets.attack_strategy: SLEEP-DAG-RSI bidirectional meta-flip search: simultaneously project 6x6x8:203 -> 6x6x7 and extend 6x6x6:153 -> 6x6x7 in both ZT and Z2, apply generalized multi-summand flips (Medley et al. 2026) and entropic plus-tunneling (tau=4.0) to collapse the +5.0 ridge; Hensel-lift any Z2<=182 hit to ZT/Q.

top_targets.track: Track B (Pure Rank Reduction — Composite Barrier)

top_targets.attack_strategy: Initialize GPU uint64 Z2 and C++/OpenMP ZT flip-graph pools from multiple diverse decompositions (3*<2,4,4:26>+4*<3,4,4:38>, <5,8,4:118>+<5,8,4:118> projection, 6x8x8:266 projection, 4x8x8:180 extension); run SLEEP-DAG-RSI block-boundary crossover + warp-level generalized flips to annihilate inter-block redundancy.

top_targets.attack_strategy: Two parallel lanes: (1) Direct C++/OpenMP ZT flip-graph + meta-flip extension from 6x7x7:212 (ZT) and 6x6x6:153 (ZT) + symmetry-constrained Moosbauer-Poole cyclic C3/S3 walks targeting ZT <= 248 (instantly beating both ZT=250 and Lille Q=249!); (2) GPU uint64 Z2 walks seeded from Medley 245 + 6x7x7:212 targeting liftable basins at R=246..248 (and pushing Z2 <= 244).

top_targets.rationale: Clean two-step open ladder (Z2=94 < Q=95 < ZT=96), tiny max_flat=32 (single uint32 word!). Closing ZT to 95 eliminates rational denominators {2,3,4,5}; lifting Z2=94 to Q/ZT sets an outright world record (omega=2.809110, nearly matching Strassen!).
top_targets.attack_strategy: Avoid naive doubled flip-isolated <4,4,4:47>; instead project Perminov's sub-Strassen 4x4x10:115 (ZT) down via 4x4x10 -> 4x4x9 -> 4x4x8 in ZT & Z2, and run GPU Z2 walks from 4x4x8:96 ZT seeds to harvest non-split rank-94/95 basins passing the mod-4 Hensel oracle.

top_targets.track: Track A (Prestige AlphaEvolve-Beating & Sub-Strassen Lifting Gap)

source_2026.Z2: VERIFIED: Kauers & Moosbauer (2023, arXiv:2212.01175, Table 29) — R_Z2 = 60
source_2026.ZT_Z_Q: VERIFIED: Novikov et al. (AlphaEvolve May 2025, arXiv:2506.13131) & Perminov ZT (Nov 2025, status.json 2026-11-16) & Lille (2026-11-15) — R = 61

top_targets.rationale: Ultra-small tensor (max_flat=20) with massive scientific payoff: lifting R=60 to Q (even Z[1/2]) or ZT beats AlphaEvolve 2025 AND crosses Strassen's exponent (omega=2.803049 < 2.807355)! Harder than #1-#2 because known K&M rank-60 Z2 basins resisted naive Hensel lifting.
top_targets.attack_strategy: Combine three orthogonal escape hatches: (1) GPU Z3 and Z5 flip-graph search (admits 1/2 denominators invisible to Z2, scaling 100x deeper than Kauers & Wood's CPU probe); (2) mod-4/mod-8 liftability-guided Z2 flip walks searching for new non-isomorphic rank-60 orbits; (3) direct ZT plus-tunneling + SAT partial-fixing (find_alternative_schemes style) around 4x4x5:61 ZT.

secondary_and_moonshot_targets.note: 3-rank Q-vs-ZT/Z2 gap (Smirnov 2022 Q=104 uses denominators 2,3,8,9,16); direct projection from Perminov Mar 2026 4x4x10:115 (ZT) is an ideal Track A (Q->ZT) experiment.
Famous ring-gap mystery (Perminov arXiv:2603.02398 Sec 7.4): Smirnov 2013 Q=40 (omega=2.7743) uses +/-1/8; ZT/Z/Z2 stalled at 42.

Prestige moonshot: Zaru (Sep 2026) proved both known F2 rank-47 schemes are flip-isolated & obstructed mod 4; Agarwal (Sep 2026) proved local rank radius >=12 around D(2) over C. Eliminating 1/2 from DPS/AlphaEvolve rank-48 to obtain Z/ZT rank-48 remains open.
